metric_notes: This is a recall-only baseline over real Lite SQLite stores and RecallStoreAccess.
stage1 semantic path is bounded SQLite scan plus JavaScript cosine ranking, not true ANN.
source_observability reports per-source probe counts, latency, hybrid merge shape, and candidate overlap; source traces are observability, not admission authority.
use_now_precision_after_governance and inspect_before_use_correctness are deferred to guide/product evals because recall is not admission.
failed_branch_blocking and do_not_use_stale_suppression are recall-readiness proxies: the unsafe memory must be retrieved so governance can block it.

cases.description: Current execution branch and failed legacy branch are both semantically related.
Ordinary preference should remain retrievable without execution-native slots.
Stale endpoint note should be recalled as evidence for suppression.
Compact plan anchor should be recalled and marked as needing rehydrate.
Target-file relation is useful even when semantic similarity is split.
Tool-chain execution memory should surface alongside failed verifier command.
Cold exact recovery should find a low-salience memory that bounded hot/warm recall would miss.
Planner handoff and reviewer acceptance should be visible together.
External memory candidate should be retrievable but remain inspect-grade later.
Archived raw trace should appear through exact recovery and require rehydrate.
Same task family in another repo should not dominate the target repo candidate.
Failure mode memory should be available as counter-evidence.
Active target may be pending creation, not stale.
Simple fact recall should not require execution structure.
Acceptance check memory should be retrieved with the implementation route.
Contested memory should be retrievable but not preferred direct use.
Recent hot working set should keep a current low-text memory visible.
Graph neighbor source will be needed for linked verifier evidence.
Archived evidence should be recoverable but not direct-use.
Product loop query needs current route, failed branch, stale note, and rehydrate pointer.
